corpus_requirements: Any Indus corpus not used in this project: ICIT texts absent from both the Mahadevan IDF-80 and Yajnadevam's inscriptions.csv, or new excavation finds. Glyphs mapped via bridge_extended.json / Mahadevan numbers. Reading order first-read-first. Deduplicate identical (site, text, emblem) before any test. Texts with >=2 signs unless stated.

predictions.name: Stroke morphology of the jar
predictions.statement: Plain jar (M342 / glyph 740) is text-final in >=60% of its tokens; jar with inner strokes (M343-345 / glyph 741) is text-final in <=15%.
predictions.falsifier: Either bound violated with >=30 tokens of the marked jar.

predictions.name: Four-stroke fish is an ending
predictions.statement: Fish with four surrounding strokes (M65? / glyph 226) is text-final in >=40% of tokens; plain fish (M59 / 220) in <=15%.
predictions.falsifier: Either bound violated with >=20 tokens of 226.

predictions.name: Count paradigm starts at three
predictions.statement: Among short-stroke numerals preceding the tree family (M161/162/169; glyphs 390/405/407), values 3-8 outnumber values 1-2 by at least 8:1.

predictions.name: Fish takes numbers as fixed words
predictions.statement: Before plain fish (220), value 5 is absent or <=5% of numeral tokens while values 3 and 6 together are >=60%.

predictions.name: Fixed compounds recur
predictions.statement: Seven+575 and seven+585 each account for >=70% of numeral tokens before 575/585; III+arrow (33+520) for >=70% of numeral tokens before the arrow.
predictions.falsifier: Any of the three below 50% with >=10 tokens.

predictions.name: Ending split by register
predictions.statement: Comb (M176 / 400) occurs on tablets at >=3x its rate on seals; jar (740) rate on tablets within 0.7-1.4x its rate on seals; man (90), arrow (520), burden-carrier (151/156) on seals at >=1.5x their tablet rate.
predictions.falsifier: Comb tablet/seal ratio <1.5, or jar ratio outside 0.5-2.0.

predictions.name: Quantity records avoid the jar
predictions.statement: Texts containing a count construction (3-8 + tree/crescent) end in the jar at <=60% of the rate of other texts.

predictions.name: Two-field tablets
predictions.statement: On two-sided tablets, one face is 'tall strokes (I-IIII) + leaf (M328 / 700)' in >=30% of objects; leaf is text-final on tablets at >=5x its seal rate; the count-face values 2, 3, 4 each exceed value 1 by >=5x.
predictions.falsifier: Leaf face <15% of two-sided tablets, or value 1 the modal count.

predictions.name: Denomination locked to type
predictions.statement: Among name-face texts attested >=5 times with a leaf face, >=50% pair with a single denomination in >=80% of their attestations.

predictions.name: Emblem independence
predictions.statement: No sign-by-field-symbol pair survives BH-FDR 5% after deduplication, at any coding granularity, with >=500 inscribed seals.
predictions.falsifier: Any pair surviving FDR whose enrichment is not attributable to duplicate impressions of one seal.

predictions.name: Seals and sealings do not co-locate
predictions.statement: Among sealings whose text matches a seal text of >=3 signs, the seal is found at a different site in >=80% of cases.

predictions.name: Substitution structure
predictions.statement: >=20% of distinct seal texts of >=3 signs have a one-substitution twin; the differing position is the sign before the ending more often than the first position.
predictions.falsifier: <10% twins, or first position dominates by >=1.5x.

predictions.name: Stability over time
predictions.statement: Where texts are dated to excavation periods, jar-final and opener rates on seals differ between earliest and latest period by <=10 percentage points.
predictions.falsifier: Either rate differs by >=20 points with >=100 seals per period.

predictions.name: Blind validator for any proposed dictionary
predictions.statement: Any sign-to-sound key that claims to read the script must produce dictionary words on unseen texts at a rate exceeding both (a) the same key applied to within-text scrambled sequences and (b) 95% of value-shuffled keys, by at least 2 standard deviations.
predictions.falsifier: Not a falsifier of the script; a criterion for accepting a decipherment. Bonta (2023) and Yajnadevam (2024) fail it.

notes: All numbers derive from the Mahadevan IDF-80 export, the GitHub database, and Yajnadevam's 5,680-object transcription, as documented in INDUS-DECIPHERMENT-ATTEMPT.md sections 1-20. Frozen before any ICIT-only or post-2024 excavation data were seen.
